text: Afternoon all spent most of the morning cleaning .Slowly working my way through the boat in what you might call a spring clean if only we had some spring. Couldn't find anything I fancied for lunch so I had something vaguely healthy instead. New [ORGANIZATION] mugs have arrived too 😃😃 [URL]

Morning all. Much better day yesterday so I took some hopeful pics of flowery things appearing. Spag bol for tea except I had rice cause I couldn't bothered with pasta. Watched [ORGANIZATION] get knocked out of the world cup. They didn't deserve to lose and were the better team 😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Perfectly lovely day today so boat jobs have been done, more kindling purchased and a quick trip to the shop. Also washed up and put the slow cooker on with pasta sauce in it ready for later. Cheeses on toast for lunch. Got some cleaning to do 😃😃 [URL]

Morning all, nice bright start to the day although whether it lasts is another thing. Yesterday was hideous, with a biting wind. On a short evening walk I was shivering in full winter gear. Hopefully not like that today. Only got off the boat to walk the dog. Old pics today 😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Bit late bit if I say I've been trying to navigate government websites it might explain why 🤣🤣 pear and pate on crackers for lunch. Still cold still wet and still bleeding windy here. Not a great day. 🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. Currently peeing down so that's an excuse not to go out yet. Very windy overnight but that's dropped off now a bit. Chicken stew for dinner, same again tonight. Going to be a cool day today so the fire is going on. 😃 All old pics today except for dinner. 😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Nipped into town for a few bits I forgot at the weekend. Couple of charity shop looks but nothing doing and a quick cheeky [LOCATION] with lemon tart to see me through. Chicken stew bubbling in the slow cooker [ORGANIZATION] [URL]

Morning all. Logged on this morning to find yesterdays lunchtime post still sitting waiting to be sent 🙄🤣 Oh well, must be getting old and a befuddled. Speaking of old, I'm [PRIVATE_TEXT] from the beginning of next month. Won't change anything. I'll keep doing stuff. 🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. Chilly and cloudy today with rain forecast later so it looks like spring is over and we're back to winter 🙄🤣 Didn't do much yesterday other than shopping which was more than enough excitement for one day.🤣 Nice easy lasagne for dinner and a [ORGANIZATION] evening 😀 [URL]
Afternoon all. Toast and pate with my lunchtime coffee. Shopping was its usual dose of high excitement , not 🤣🤣. Been nice today but clouding over now 🙄 [URL]

Morning all another chuffing chilly morning . Shopping day today. Can't wait 🙄😂😂. Leftover stew and [PERSON] reruns for dinner.😃😃 Flowers are starting to bloom and the ducks are getting [PERSON] so I think it's safe to say spring has sprung😂😂 [URL]

Afternoon all. Gorgeous sunny day although not as warm as it has been. That's why I've decided to have the soup I got out on Tuesday for lunch but didn't have. 🤣🤣. Mind you ill gladly eat soup whatever the weather. Been washing the boat down a bit. Need something to kill moss😀 [URL]

Morning all. Bright but chilly start to what promises to be a decent day. Got distracted yesterday helping a neighbour sort out their boat ready to go out next week. Nice sunset and beef stew for dinner. Pretty sure the dog got more meat than me 🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. [PERSON] pretty crappy most of the day yesterday so I wasn't about much. Feeling OK today so it was something or nothing. Sad news about [PERSON] being in financial trouble. I always loved [ORGANIZATION] stuff so I've just ordered a couple of mugs. Not cheap but iconic. 😃😃 [URL]

Morning all. Gorgeous day yesterday, so much so that I made the decision to wash my car, very slowly...I don't wash cars. I've never really seen the point, so this was a major event 😂.I've even provided photo evidence for any doubters 😂 Other than that, it was work & walks😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Lovely dsy so far. 21c in the boat. Doors open. Me in just a T-shirt on the top half, it's like summer has arrived 😁. Coffee and quiche for lunch. Then its back to work...or sleep, whatever 😀😀 [URL]

Morning all. Another dull day yesterday with just a bit of sunshine. Didn't do a lot other than walk [ORGANIZATION] and a bit of editing. Not even a decent sunset so pics are old ones. Sardines on toast for tea. Chicken stew going in the slow cooker today 😋👍 [URL]

Afternoon all. Gone cloudy here now after a sunny start. No afternoon pic today. I was going to have cheese and crackers then I realised I'd run out of cheese...and crackers, so just a pear for lunch and everyone knows what a pear looks like. Trip to the shop needed I think. 😃
[PERSON], thanks and you too 😃😃

Morning all. Thanks for all the good wishes. I appreciate them all. Still feeling a bit flat but I do have another little mutt to look after so he has all my attention. Took [PET] for a long walk in the sun yesterday morning which we haven't done for ages. He slept all day [LOCATION] [URL]

Morning all, just jumped on to say thanks for all the good wishes yesterday. I think I've replied to everyone who left a comment but if I missed any, then apologies and thank you. Didn't take any pics yesterday. Not in the mood but I'll be back with normal service tomorrow👍
Thanks [ORGANIZATION]

Morning all. Apologies for not replying to anyone yesterday afternoon. Stressful day. Had to take my old dog [PERSON] on his final trip to the vet yesterday so a very stressful afternoon. Not really feeling it today, so I won't be around much if at all. Maybe tomorrow. [URL]

Morning all, a thoroughly unpleasant day yesterday weather-wise. The high winds have dropped to just a bit gusty now and then thank goodness. Not too much rain which was good. Bacon sarnie and a mug of soup for tea. 😋 The rest are old pics. 😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Pear and cheese lunch again. I have got coffee too but got over excited and took the pic too early 🙂 Very windy currently but not too much rain which I'm glad about but bound to start about half four when I want to take the dogs out 🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. Bit blowy, on it's way to being very windy and wet according to the forecast. The boat will be rocking but for all the wrong reasons😃 decent day yesterday, bit of a sunset and mostly sunny all day. Leftover chicken stew nuked in the microwave for dinner. 😋😋😃😃 [URL]
Afternoon all. Been nice and bright with a couple of teeny showers so far. Been and ordered done cool to be delivered onto the boat tomorrow to save my back. Steak bake and coffee time.😁😁 [URL]

Morning all. Nice bright start which I've made the most of by walking the dogs before posting. Mainly because I forgot 😂Chicken stew/casserole for dinner done in the slow cooker. [PERSON] lovely and plenty left over for today and the dogs 😃. Another cold gloomy day yesterday 😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Sunny-ish day so far but clouding up a bit. Laundry almost finished so the front of the boat will be like a chinese laundry soon as it dries by the fire. Coffee time with a pear and some extra mature cheddar for lunch. Chicken stew bubbling in the slow cooker😃😃 [URL]

Morning all. Bit of a bright start here which is encouraging. Don't suppose it'll last. No real sign of any good weather upcoming according to the weather guessers. Shopping day yesterday. I could barely contain myself with excitement 🤣🤣. Old pics again as it was a gloomy day😃 [URL]

Morning all bit late this morning but better late than never. Out with my lad yesterday to complete a hectic weekend. Ham egg and chips in spoons at lunchtime set me up for the day. [PERSON] o' soup in the evening finished it off. Shopping delayed by a day so I'm off to do that soon😃 [URL]

Morning all. Had a bit of a day away yesterday. Daughter came over in the morning for a quick visit. She's moving  so she has a million things to do. Lil sis came over lunchtime so we visited the café in the local gliding club. Couldn't resist a bit of cheesecake to go too. 😋😋 [URL]

Morning all. Spag bol in the slow cooker again. Bloody lovely & there's some pasta underneath all that sauce. I left putting the teeny weeny amount of cheese I had on until I took the pic so as not to block the sauce out 😃 work and more cleaning yesterday. Kitchen is spotless 🤣 [URL]

Afternoon all. Time for a bit o' lunch after a bit o' cleaning and a bit o' work this morning. Cleaning didn't take long and if I did it more often even less time. Trouble is, with the dogs it'll be mucky later today never mind by tomorrow 🤣🤣 Quiche for a snack 😋 [URL]

Morning all. Back to the gloom here today after a lovely day yesterday 🙄 The boat got up to 22c with no heating on & no fire so hopefully we get a few more days like that soon.👍👍 Leftover chicken stew for tea. Bloomin lovely it was and the dogs got some too 😃 Flowers showing [URL]

Afternoon all. Managed one claw on small dog before he went nuclear. So its going to have to be an expensive vet sedation job instead 🙄. Trimmed my beard and did some slow cleaning instead. Resting up this afternoon to let the twinges go off. Gorgeous day here. Cheese on toast😋 [URL]

Morning all. Nice bright start to the day after a dull one yesterday with the odd glimpse of sun. A work day for me mostly although little dog had his 2nd batch of clipping which he hated. Nails today😱 then he's done thank God. Chicken stew out of the slow cooker for tea. 😀 [URL]

Afternoon all. [ORGANIZATION]amp; a bit of cheese for the lunchtime snack. Busy working this morning, trying to edit books that I wrote eleven years ago 😱 in readiness for the next in the series later in the year. Not as nice today as I thought it would be, kind of dull with a bit of sun [URL]

Morning all. Strange kind of day yesterday. Took little doggo for an early bath and trim. He absolutely hates it and it is such a stressful event for all concerned, It actually made me feel ill for most of the morning. Everything was late after that, At least it was dry. 
😃😃 [URL]

Morning all. Cold and gloomy this morning but for the record yesterday was first day of this year where I didn't have or need the fire on all day. Twere lovely and the boat got up to 22c just from the sun. Kind of a nice sunset and a full moon too. Lasagne for tea.😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Managed about 75% of my to do list but resting now as I'm getting twinges so other than stuff I can do sat on my backside, that's me done. Gorgeous day outside. 😁😁 Steak bake for lunch 👍👍 [URL]

Morning all. Outside looks chilly & dry for a change with a dry and dare I say it sunny day in prospect. Got a to do list a mile long having been laid up for so long with my back. Needless to say, I'll be doing them slowly and carefully. Sausage and [ORGANIZATION] for tea, pasty for lunch😋 [URL]

Morning all, hopeful speckles of blue sky this morning. Yesterday ended up not too bad with a half-decent sunset. More rain in the night though. Dinner was left over spag bol but jacket spud and cheese instead of spag. Shopping today which I'm sure will be as joyous as ever 🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. I've been sitting here thinking what a wonderfully dry, warm and sunny start it was to the day. Then I woke up. It's grey, wet and frankly bleeding miserable again. Been raining pretty much all night. So very fed up with it. Spag bol minus the spag for dinner. 😂😂 [URL]
Afternoon all. Cheese n biscuits with my coffee. Been dull mild and horrendously humid here with a couple of biblical showers to boot. Nasty day all round but hey, it's nearly the weekend 😁😁 [URL]

Morning all. Pretty grotty day yesterday with the crowning glory when it peed down as I was out dog walking. Deep joy. Leftover chicken stew for dinner which was bloody lovely if I say so myself. Slow cooker of course. No new pics yesterday so oldies again today. [URL]

Afternoon all, time for a snack and coffee. Fruit and cheese today with one of the two bananas a week I limit myself to. Lots of starchy carbs in bananas so limited amounts now. Been to the shop-needed cheese😃 bought some coal. Just need someone to load it in the boat 😃😃 [URL]

Morning all. A pleasant day all round yesterday & although it was only slow & carefully, I got stuff done. Today, I won't , just to be careful with my back/leg which is slowly getting there. It's reached the fading soreness level instead of painful so 🤞 it'll fade away soon.😃😃 [URL]
[PERSON] it certainly is 😃😃

Afternoon all. Busy morning, work, dumped rubbish, emptied cassette, laundry, chicken casserole in the slow cooker. Very careful  doing it do it all takes longer than normal. Lovely day so far. 19c with doors front and back open. Coffee, pear, cheese 😁😁 [URL]

Morning all. After my pasty lunch I wasn't really hungry yesterday evening so pate on toast it was. Both dogs got a dollop when I was finished. We actually got a decent sunset and on my evening walk even more signs that nature is rousing itself for spring. It was a nice day 😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all, it's coffee time, and coincidentally pasty time too. Had to eat it today or it'll be out of date. Been OK here today. Bit of sun, bit of cloud. The boat is 18.5c with no heating on so no complaints there. As long it doesn't rain about half four I'll be happy 😂 [URL]

Morning all. A grey wet day emerged yesterday after a bit of early brightness. Today has started grey and dull in readiness for another cheerful day...not.😂 Air fried chicken and rice for tea last night. Uninspiring but tasty and filling plus the dogs got a bit of chicken😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Work this morning, more work this afternoon  interspersed with coffee, cheese and biscuits and a nice ripe, firm, juicy pear which is the best sort and something I greatly enjoy getting my hands on 😉😂😂 [ORGANIZATION] and ever so slightly upwards 😂😂 [URL]

Morning all. Pasty from Morrisons for lunch. V Tasty. Jacket spud with tuna and cheese for tea was bloody lovely. Nice day mostly yesterday with a nice bit of sunshine and no rain after an early morning shower. Even got a sunset and the first flowers showing through 😃😃 [URL]

Morning all. Quiche for lunch and a bacon sarnie and a mug of tomato soup for tea with some fruit after. Cooked some sausages up too for breakfast with some eggs if I can be bothered. If not the dogs are in for a treat.😂 Peeing down again so no change there. Shopping later😱🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. Reheated bol leftovers with a couple of slices of thinly buttered bread for tea. Minimal effort. Little to no standing up. Suits me 🤣🤣 Miserable grey damp cold day yesterday. More of the same today by all accounts but a bit warmer. Where's the sun gone? 😁🤣 [URL]

Afternoon all. Another dull and damp day. In need of milk and cheering up, I nipped to the shop and got myself something I haven't had in ages, besides an obliging lady friend that is 😉, namely a sausage roll. Blooming lovely it was too. Back to work again now 🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. Spag bol done in the slow cooker was very tasty. Couldn't be bothered with the spag bit so I had a jacket spud instead 🤣 I thought the whole thing needed a bit of extra flavour so added a miniscule sprinkling of cheese too. 😂😂 spring is coming! Slowly.😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Coffee and snack time. Busy morning today. Took recycling and rubbish to the bins and emptied the toilet. Also put a spag bol going in the slow cooker Did everything very slowly and carefully [LOCATION] took forever 🙄🤣🤣 [URL]
Thanks [PERSON]. Looking forward to a time when the weather lets me get out and take some nice pics again 😃😃

Morning all. The much-delayed meet with my lad finally went ahead. [PERSON] was consumed, chat was had and I managed to manoeuvre around Market [PERSON] with little pain, just a bit of discomfort. Today, doing similar with lil sis 😂😂 No cooking for me again today. 😋😋 [URL]

Afternoon all. Time for coffee and a small snackette. It's been what's affectionately known as changeable weather here today. Come rain or shine (mostly rain) and its gathering again now. Oh well, normality resumes 🤣🤣 back to the grind [ORGANIZATION] [URL]

Morning all. Another mostly wet day yesterday until evening dog walk time when for some strange but welcome reason it cleared up and we got a bit of colour in the sky. Managed the marina walk again although it hurt more yesterday. Jacket spud with cheese and tuna for tea. 😃😃😋 [URL]

Afternoon all. Its finally stopped freakin' raining. What a miserable cold morning. I've done not a lot and plan to do the same this pm. Just a coffee and a teeny-weeny treat as I had a rather large breakfast [ORGANIZATION] [URL]

Morning all. Lovely day yesterday. Raining this morning but no snow thank god. Managed a trip round [ORGANIZATION] and [PERSON] AND a walk round the marina for the first time in ten days. It was slow and I needed a walking stick but I made it. Sausage Jacket spud and beans for tea.😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Sorry for no replies this morning yet, I've been on an outing😃😃 The lady who's cat I look after offered to take me shopping as driving isn't particularly easy, but I managed to get around [ORGANIZATION] and [PERSON]...slowly and with a walking stick with no ill effect😃😃 [URL]

Good morning & Happy Valentine's Day to all, apart from the weirdos🤣. Very odd night. Bed just gone 11. Woke up at 1. Absolutely wide awake. Eventually needed a pee. Sat up until 3 before I was tired again.  Finished the casserole last night. Part baked bread in airfryer😋 [URL]

Afternoon all. Not wishing to jinx it but the back and leg do feel a bit better today. I managed to hobble around the shop without having to stop and lean on something every ten steps. Also needed coal so got that loaded into the car for me. [ORGANIZATION] and cheese turnover 😃😃 [URL]

Morning all. Just getting light. Looks dull. Can't hear any rain so might be off to a dry start for a change. Nothing very much happening at the moment although some green shoots of mainly daffs are showing but spring still feels a long way ahead. We plod on 😃😃 Beef stew😋 [URL]

Afternoon all. Just coffee for lunch today as I didn't have breakfast until late. Been almost dry for most of the morning but no sun today. I have a beef casserole cooking in the slow cooker ready for tonight...and tomorrow...and quite possibly the day after too 🤣🤣

Morning all, another damp start, another grey day in prospect, what joy. Slight improvement in the [PRIVATE_TEXT] yesterday but painful again this morning. Nothing to do outside the boat other than dog walks so it'll get plenty of rest. Quiche and salad for tea. 😋 [URL]

Afternoon all. [ORGANIZATION]'s out AND it's raining. How does that work?😂😂 Etsy order packed and taken up to the post office. Driving is fun with one dodgy leg. Fortunately it's not far away. Also did the job I can't ask anyone to help with ie emptying the toilet cassette. Pasty time.😋 [URL]

Morning all, just getting light. I can hear the delightful patter of gentle rain falling on the covers encouraging me to stay in the boat rather than take the dogs out. Miserable. Was in pain again last night so an easy tea of sardines on toast  I could make sitting down. 😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. The morning has flashed by today. Tomato soup for lunch. with a crusty roll to dip in it. Dull and miserable again today. Yesterday was just a brief respite 🤣🤣. The morning went by in a flash today. [URL]

Afternoon all. I've run out of coffee pods for my machine!! Good job some more are coming today 😃😃 [ORGANIZATION] sarnie for lunch cause I'm hungry. Not done a lot other than work today other than washing up while sitting down on a hard chair. Bit weird but it doesn't hurt so sod it🤣🤣 [URL]

Looks like the sword has been fallen upon
[URL]

Afternoon all. I've been doing a lot of sitting down without any pain. Then I stood up to make coffee and a snackette. It hurt within twenty seconds of standing, stupid leg. So I sat back down 🤣 and that's where I'll be until doggo time. 😃😃 [URL]

Morning all. Another miserable wet night overnight here like we needed some more rain 🤣🤣. The back is still playing up so I did a shopping order for delivery tomorrow so I don't have to walk round Morrisons stopping to stretch every ten steps🤣 People might think I was odd.🤣😃 [URL]

Morning all. Bit late this morning, got side tracked on something. Back feels a bit better again today but it's when i start to walk the dogs the test will come 😃 It's NOT raining...yet🤣 Jacket spud with tuna & cheese and a bit of salad for tea last night. Flooded stream pic😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Feeling happier this afternoon. Sent out an order, got some coal (someone put it in the car for me. It's still there for now) Did the washing and drying up sitting down which was fun & now having coffee and a quiche for lunch after a big bowl of porridge earlier 😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Busy morning. Editing, breakfast, dog walking, fetching logs, getting a prescription, and tweaking my back again, not necessarily in that order. Still dull, wet and miserable here. Will it ever end? Pasty time. Steak 😋😋😀😀 [URL]

Morning all. It's a truly delightful morning here today...not. It's raining, windy, and grey. It did finally brighten up yesterday just in time for the sun to go down. Dinner was a gammon sarny with some red onion chutney, a bit of cucumber and some extra cheese for the dogs😃😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. No photo today as I'm just having coffee. Couldn't find anything I fancied to eat other than a couple of ibuprofen  for my leg🤣 The sun has been trying to come out here, not very hard admittedly, but it has been trying. I shall get back to work for a while now 😃

Morning all. It's a gorgeous morning here. In my dreams 😂😂. In reality, it's dull with a monotonous grey sky much like it's been for the last couple of weeks. it's not raining, which is a plus. Slow cooker gammon this week, finished in the air fryer, served on salad with eggs😋 [URL]

Afternoon all. Lunch is pate on crackers which has resulted in dogs gazing at my plate longingly
Needless to say I shall give in and share a morsel with them 🤣. Been cold here all day so far with a biting wind. Stupid Winter, roll on spring 🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. Chilly this morning. Dinner was jacket spud with cheese and beans. I forgot the photo so had to take it when it was half-eaten. 😂 The rest are old pics as yesterday was dull and miserable all day. More work today. More editing. Nearly time for the mutts to go out 😃 [URL]

Afternoon all. Bit late as I've been nattering with lil sis. Been a very dull day so far weather wise but no rain as such. Did a couple of boaty jobs this morning, bit of work then time for coffee and cheese and crackers ready for an equally exciting afternoon 🙄🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. Barely daylight yet. Roll on lighter mornings. Had a very relaxed weekend doing editing and trying not to move 🤣. The lad couldn't get a train yesterday so we rescheduled for next weekend.  Soup for lunch. Cheese and bacon sarnie for tea. Signs of spring emerging 😀 [URL]

Morning all, had a bit of a day off from everything yesterday and probably will today for most of the day as my lad is coming over & treating me to a spoons breakfast so I'll be out for a while. Didn't even feel like cooking yesterday so an unappetising ready meal had to do 😂 [URL]

Morning all. Poor night last night. Couldn't get comfortable. Spent the evening with a heat pack against my back which didn't help either. Beef soup for dinner. Basically what was left of the brisket in the cooking juices with some bread. Bloody lovely it was & the dogs helped 😋 [URL]

Afternoon all. The sun has come out and it's stopped raining for now. I've had to take off a layer because it's warm on the boat now and opening a window isn't cooling it down. After my meat pasty the other day, I thought I'd revisit the Cheese and Onion version today 😋😋 [URL]

Morning all. Pissing down here to be blunt. According to the [ORGANIZATION] it's going to be pissing down 24/7 for the next two weeks so that's joyous news 😂😂. Only one pic which was dinner from yesterday the rest from the last few days. I'll definitely be having brisket again. Tonight😂 [URL]

Back in the 60s my kid sisters hid behind cushions while watching [PERSON] Who. Who'd have thought, sixty years later, I'd be hiding behind a cushion cringing at the bunch of no-hopers on [ORGANIZATION] If these people are the great entrepreneurial hope for the future, then I'm out.😂

Afternoon all. Today, I'll mostly be having a liquid lunch. Soup in one mug, coffee in another makes a very fine pair😉. Work this morning. The dog walk eased off the leg pain but it's since come back so hopefully the dog walk later will shift it again. Dull and miserable here.😃 [URL]

Morning all. [PRIVATE_TEXT] back with a vengeance this morning. Painkillers have been consumed. Hopefully the dog walk will ease it a bit. Cooked a brisket in the slow cooker for 9 hours with an onion and some red wine. Why have I not had this before? It was like eating butter 😋😋 [URL]

Afternoon all. Pasty for lunch. Haven't had one in what seems like ages.The sun has been out warming up the boat, saving some coal which is great. Another load of laundry in. My left leg feels like a lump of lead with pain through the thigh and knee but we carry on [ORGANIZATION] [URL]

Morning all. After a bit of relief yesterday, the [PRIVATE_TEXT] is back this morning but not as bad as it was. I'll see how I go walking the dogs. Haven't been out yet but it looks cold. Today is filing the tax return day woohoo. Can't wait 🙄🤣 Dinner was an (air) fry up 🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning. Slept better but still up at 4. Trying to walk yesterday was a pain having to stop every ten yards & stretch so I could walk another ten. Must have looked a right divvy 😂. Blowing a hoolie here & raining so the dog walk can wait. Best dinner I could manage. Old pics.😃 [URL]

Morning all. Not going to lie, I'm struggling this morning. No matter what I did I couldn't get comfortable last night so I was awake until gone 2am mostly whimpering and cursing then awake again at 5.30, mostly cursing and whimpering. Sitting offers some relief. [PRIVATE_TEXT]👍 [URL]
Afternoon all . Shopping as per usual this morning. Struggling with [PRIVATE_TEXT] First bout I've had for a good while but fed up with it already. Tomato soup for lunch 😋😋

Morning all. Its nearly daylight out there. Roll on the lighter mornings. No afternoon update yesterday as I was out on a short unplanned afternoon meet up with the daughter. Coffee but definitely no cappuccino cake 😉 honest. Slow cooker spag bol minus the spag for tea [ORGANIZATION] [URL]

Morning all another dull miserable day yesterday broken up by the mercy mission. I'll update when I find out how my fellow boater's fingers are doing. Had a pot of soup/broth on the go in the slow cooker all day so that was dinner. Other than that, nothing happened 😂😂 [URL]

Afternoon all. Bit late as I got called upon for a mercy mission to take a fellow boater to the nearest emergency treatment centre after he dropped the hatch of his boat onto two of his fingers, slicing them open. Tomato soup to dampen the adrenaline when I got back 😀😀 [URL]

Morning all. Only one new photo today which is my dinner. Other than that it was just another dull day with another one in prospect today with even more rain. If I yell THE CANALS ARE FULL NOW do you think it might stop? 🤣🤣 Other pics are all old ones from a better time 🤣 [URL]

Afternoon all. Quick dash out this morning to stock up on a couple of things. Then I  was lugging bags of coal and kindling about, then I had coffee and crackers with some Ardennes pate for a change. [ORGANIZATION]amp; low in carbs. High in everything else but apparently only carbs count 🤣 [URL]

Morning all. A pretty dull wet day in paradise yesterday. Spent the day working with a gammon joint in the slow cooker. Never tried it before and it came out beautifully. Finished it in the air fryer with a tiny bit of honey and mustard which also worked pretty good. 👍👍😀😀 [URL]

Afternoon all . Dull dismal and damp today. Not nice at all. Lunch is cheese and crackers and an apple. Was going for the rice cakes but decided I'd prefer to enjoy it 🤣🤣. Hope it dries up for everyone 😀😀 [URL]

Morning all. It was lil sis's birthday last Friday so after her birthday weekend/week/month, I offered to treat her to lunch which she graciously accepted🤣. We both had difficulty finding something healthy on the menu so decided to f*ck off the diets and go for it 🤣🤣 [URL]

Morning all. Another day, another downpour and another dull sky. It's day 20 of the 4357 in January 🤣🤣. Nothing much happened other than work and having to have doors and windows open on the boat as it was too hot with the fire on 🤣. Sausages and salad for tea. Old pics today. [URL]
Afternoon all. Not much to report other than cheese on toast for lunch, still dull and miserable and seemingly getting colder and that I remembered to press post today 😂😂 [URL]

Morning all. Wish the brighter mornings would hurry up. Dull and grey and barely light yet. Even the dogs aren't pestering me yet. Nothing exciting happening today, just work. Oh and prepping for a tax return 🤢. There, now I've cheered everyone up, I'm off 🤣🤣 [URL]

Afternoon all. Shopping this morning . Fridge now chock a block. Lunch is high protein rice cakes with cheese to take away the cardboard flavour and chipboard texture 🤣🤣 I've had worse things I must say. Dull and pretty misty today 😀😀 [URL]
